# opnsense_zenarmor_status (Data Source)

Reports package, engine, database, licence, and capability information exposed by the local OPNsense Zenarmor controller.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_zenarmor_status" "current" {}

output "zenarmor_plugin_version" {
  value = data.opnsense_zenarmor_status.current.plugin_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agent_version` (String) Installed `os-sensei-agent` package version, or null when it is not installed.
- `application_database_version` (String) Zenarmor application database version.
- `cloud_access_supported` (Boolean) Whether cloud threat-intelligence access is enabled.
- `edition` (String) Zenarmor edition reported by the local controller.
- `engine_status` (Boolean) Whether the Zenarmor engine is running.
- `engine_version` (String) Zenarmor engine version.
- `full_tls_inspection_supported` (Boolean) Whether full TLS inspection is positively advertised as supported.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for the local Zenarmor installation.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the `os-sensei` Zenarmor plugin is installed.
- `license_status` (String) Raw licence status reported by the local controller.
- `plugin_version` (String) Installed `os-sensei` package version, or null when it is not installed.
- `supported_features` (List of String) Deterministically ordered capabilities positively advertised by the local controller.
- `threat_database_version` (String) Threat database version when separately advertised by the installed release.
- `tls_inspection_supported` (Boolean) Whether TLS inspection is positively advertised as supported.
- `updater_version` (String) Installed `os-sensei-updater` package version, or null when it is not installed.
